description: A proposed supersession/retraction relation between two memory claims (MemoryRelationProposal, src/memory/model.rs), crossing the wire nested in the memory_propose_supersession / memory_propose_retraction results as `relation_proposal`. Found uncontracted by the adversarial-execution-reviewer's pass on ADR 0034: layers 1 and 2 are top-level-only by design, so a nested claim like this one needs its own payload contract, exactly as MemoryClaimProposal's siblings already have. accepted and review_status are pinned const and required (#117's pattern — const alone is evadable by omitting the field): this record can never truthfully claim acceptance or a reviewed status, because only the canonical review morphism accepts anything.
